mc.client.resources.PlayerSkin.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.player.PlayerSkin
mc.client.resources.PlayerSkin.note: 1.21.9 起 PlayerSkin 移到 net.minecraft.world.entity.player，纹理改为 ClientAsset：skin.texture() -> skin.body().texturePath()

mc.client.input.MouseButtonEvent.name: net.minecraft.client.input.MouseButtonEvent
mc.client.input.MouseButtonEvent.note: 1.21.9 引入：界面鼠标按键回调参数，event.x()/y()/button()/modifiers()

mc.client.input.CharacterEvent.name: net.minecraft.client.input.CharacterEvent
mc.client.input.CharacterEvent.note: 1.21.9 引入：字符输入回调参数，event.codepoint()/modifiers()

mc.client.Screen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen
mc.client.Screen.note: 1.21.9 起键鼠回调改为事件对象：keyPressed(KeyEvent)、keyReleased(KeyEvent)、charTyped(CharacterEvent)、mouseClicked(MouseButtonEvent, boolean 双击)、mouseReleased(MouseButtonEvent)、mouseDragged(MouseButtonEvent, double, double)；覆写声明与 super 调用都要改参数

mc.client.KeyMapping.name: net.minecraft.client.KeyMapping
mc.client.KeyMapping.note: 1.21.9 起分类不再是字符串：构造最后一参为 KeyMapping.Category，自定义分类用 KeyMapping.Category.register(ResourceLocation) 创建，并在 RegisterKeyMappingsEvent#registerCategory 中登记

mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRenderer
mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.note: 1.21.9 起 BlockEntityRenderer<T, S extends BlockEntityRenderState>：实现 createRenderState()、extractRenderState(...) 复制数据，submit(state, PoseStack, SubmitNodeCollector, CameraRenderState) 提交绘制，旧 render 已移除

mc.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer
mc.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer.note: 1.21.9 起 render 改为 submit(state, PoseStack, SubmitNodeCollector, CameraRenderState)，绘制通过 SubmitNodeCollector 提交

forge.FMLEnvironment.name: net.neoforged.fml.loading.FMLEnvironment
forge.FMLEnvironment.note: FML 10（NeoForge 21.9）起 dist/production 字段改为方法 getDist()/isProduction()，其余加载状态经 FMLLoader.getCurrent() 访问

forge.ForgeCapabilities.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.capabilities.Capabilities
forge.ForgeCapabilities.note: NeoForge 21.9 转移重构：Capabilities.ItemHandler/FluidHandler/EnergyStorage 改为 Capabilities.Item/Fluid/Energy，对应的能力类型变为 ResourceHandler<ItemResource>、ResourceHandler<FluidResource>、EnergyHandler

forge.items.IItemHandler.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandler
forge.items.IItemHandler.note: NeoForge 21.9 起已弃用（计划移除），新代码用 ResourceHandler<ItemResource>；旧实现可用 IItemHandler.of(handler) 与新接口互转

forge.energy.IEnergyStorage.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.energy.IEnergyStorage
forge.energy.IEnergyStorage.note: NeoForge 21.9 起已弃用，新接口为 net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.energy.EnergyHandler（IEnergyStorage.of 可互转）

forge.fluids.IFluidHandler.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.fluids.capability.IFluidHandler
forge.fluids.IFluidHandler.note: NeoForge 21.9 起已弃用，新代码用 ResourceHandler<FluidResource>（IFluidHandler.of 可互转）
